**How to use this brief:**
1. **Screenshots are visual ground truth** — match them before consulting the layer tree
2. **Understand frame groups** — full-page frames contain the complete design; viewport-state frames show scroll positions for reference only
3. **Use components, don't rebuild them** — instantiate from the component index by name with the right props
4. **Follow variable bindings** — use `$token` values, never hardcode a matching raw value; `⚠` flags values that should be bound
5. **Recreate top-down** — frame → auto-layout sections → component instances → details
6. **Ignore** — viewport state frames (reference only), `👁hidden` layers, computed fill/hug dimensions
7. **Cite by node ID** — use `#id` references (stable across exports), not line numbers (which drift)
8. **Responsive implementation** — pixel dimensions are reference only; implement using grid columns (`col-span`), flex/fill sizing, aspect ratios, and variable tokens. The Variable Tokens section shows how values change across modes

**Themes:** light (`8:3`) · dark (`26:0`) · bttf (`4701:1`)

**Build standards:**
1. **Repeated property combinations become a class** — when the same combination of properties appears on more than one node, implement it as one named class/utility applied by name, never re-declared per surface or inlined. Inline `style=` only for truly per-instance computed values. Name the role (`.blend-ink`), not the properties.
2. **Semantic structure** — use elements that describe what content *is*, not how it looks. Navigation is `<nav>`, a list of items is `<ul>`/`<ol>`, a page region is a landmark (`<header>`, `<main>`, `<footer>`, `<aside>`). Heading levels follow document outline, not visual size.
3. **Token-first values** — every `$token` in this brief must resolve to a variable/token in code (CSS custom property, Tailwind theme value, or equivalent), never a hardcoded literal that happens to match. If the design says `$spacing/lg`, code says `var(--spacing-lg)` or the framework equivalent — not `24px`.
4. **Component boundaries match the design** — if this brief shows a `◆instance of`, it is a component in code with the same name, same props, same boundary. Do not flatten instances into inline markup or split one instance across multiple components.
5. **Grid frames are CSS Grid containers** — a `[Grid]` frame is a CSS `display: grid` container in code; children are placed by `grid-column: span N`, never by widths computed from column maths. `col-span(N/M)` maps directly to `grid-column: span N` on an M-column grid.

Fades-in on scroll up
Page end fades in
sm:
Fades out on scroll down
Title only fades-in on scroll up

All breakpoints:
Full swipe/rise motion law  on page reload 
Between pages, Full swipe/rise motion law if different content, if no content change it stays persistent. [→](https://figma.com/design/FILEKEY?node-id=3023-12975)

md+: 
Stays fixed on page as you scroll


sm:

- **NavigationHeader** (COMPONENT_SET) #3023:12975 1312×hug clip 📝Development: The content of the HeaderNavigation is contextual, depending on the page, Title, Description and actions will change.


At sm+ (md) breakpoint NavigationSecondary is used for actions. Positioned at the bottom of the viewport · Interaction: Scroll behaviour
md+:
Fades-out on scroll down
Fades-in on scroll up
Page end fades in
sm:
Fades out on scroll down
Title only fades-in on scroll up
Page end fades in · Interaction: Motion
All breakpoints:
Full swipe/rise motion law  on page reload 
Between pages, Full swipe/rise motion law if different content, if no content change it stays persistent. [→](https://figma.com/design/FILEKEY?node-id=3023-12975)
  **Responsive via:** `device` property (lg+ → md → sm)
  **Responsive grid:** 12-col

  | Child | lg+ | md | sm |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | size (w×h) | $device/width×hug | $device/width×hug | $device/width×hug |
  | title | col-span 3/12 | col-span 3/12 | col-span 6/12 |
  | description | col-span 4/12 | col-span 5/12 | col-span 12/12 |
  | action | col-span 4/12 | col-span 4/12 | col-span 6/12 |
  | colGap | $grid/gap-sm | $grid/gap-sm | $grid/gap | ⚠ token-swap
  | rowGap | — | — | $grid/gap-lg | ⚠ variant-only
  | padding (v/h) | $space/spacer-200 / $grid/margin-offset | $space/spacer-200 / $grid/margin-offset | $space/spacer-300 / $grid/margin-default | ⚠ token-swap
  ⚠ **sm** wraps to 2 rows (row 1: title + action, row 2: description)
